entities.summary: Maud Kamatenesi Mugisha is an Ugandan natural scientist and academic administrator. She is the former vice chancellor of Bishop Stuart University, a private chartered higher education institution in Uganda, accredited by the Uganda National Council for Higher Education. Since 1 March 2023, she has been serving as the chairperson of the University Council at Kampala International University.
